product.description: Stage Right™ by Monoprice™Professional Conferencing Supercardioid Condenser MicrophoneAmplify Your Communication with Crystal-Clear, Professional-Grade SoundThe Stage Right™ Professional Conferencing Supercardioid Condenser Microphone is expertly engineered to deliver crystal-clear sound for meetings, speeches, broadcasts, and recordings. Featuring a flexible metal gooseneck and a durable plastic base with a touch-sensitive power switch, these features allow for precise positioning and easy control. The supercardioid polar pattern captures your voice with pinpoint accuracy while minimizing background noise, ensuring your words are delivered with clarity and warmth in any environment—from conference rooms to live broadcasts.This versatile microphone offers a wide frequency range of 20Hz to 20kHz and is powered by either AAA batteries or +48V phantom power. With an impressive dynamic range of 110dB and a signal-to-noise ratio of 69dB, it ensures that your voice comes through loud and clear, without distortion. The microphone's balanced 68-ohm output impedance and its removable foam pop filter further enhance sound quality by reducing unwanted noise.Included with the microphone is everything you need for a professional-grade audio setup: a 26-foot XLR cable, an XLR to ¼-inch TS adapter, and a sturdy and removable foam pop filter. The 16.14-inch (410-millimeter) microphone length and its lightweight 1.76-pound (0.8-kilogram) design make it an easy addition to any setup, whether mounted on its base or plugged directly into a mixer or PA system.Supercardioid polar pattern minimizes background noise for clear, focused audio captureIntegrated volume control on the base allows precise adjustment for optimal sound levels, giving you more control during meetings and presentationsFlexible metal gooseneck design allows precise microphone positioning for optimal sound qualityVersatile power options with AAA batteries or +48V phantom power supportWide frequency range of 20Hz to 20kHz delivers full-spectrum sound for professional applicationsDurable plastic base with an electronic touch switch provides easy, reliable controlIncludes a 26-foot XLR cable and XLR to ¼-inch TS adapter for versatile connectivity optionsLightweight 1.76-pound design and 16.14-inch length make it ideal for conference rooms, broadcasts, and presentations  SUPERCARDIOID POLAR PATTERNThe supercardioid polar pattern is designed to focus on your voice while rejecting unwanted background noise. This ensures that your audience hears you clearly, making it perfect for busy environments like conference rooms and live events. INTEGRATED VOLUME CONTROLThe convenient volume control on the base of the microphone allows you to easily adjust audio levels during your presentation or meeting. This unique feature gives you greater control over your sound, ensuring that your voice is always at the perfect volume without the need for additional equipment. FLEXIBLE METAL GOOSENECK DESIGNWith its flexible metal gooseneck, this microphone can be easily adjusted to capture your voice from the optimal angle. Whether you're sitting or standing, your audio is always crisp and clear, enhancing the overall quality of your communication. WIDE FREQUENCY RANGEThe Stage Right™ microphone boasts a wide frequency range of 20Hz to 20kHz, capturing the full richness of your voice. This capability is crucial for professional applications, providing a natural and engaging audio experience that resonates with your audience. DURABLE AND RELIABLE CONSTRUCTIONBuilt with a durable plastic base and metal gooseneck, this microphone is designed to withstand the rigors of frequent use.
